Looking at the diff, every changed line is a documentation/comment update or a test assertion message string — no functional code changes:

- `GhosttyApp.swift`: comment text change only ("GhosttyKit 1.2.3" → "the pinned GhosttyKit")
- `GhosttySurfaceView.swift`: two comment text changes only
- `TerminalSearch.swift`: two comment text changes only
- `GhosttyAppTests.swift`: XCTAssertTrue failure-message string change only
- `GhosttySurfaceViewTests.swift`: comment text change only
- `RunStatusUITests.swift`: comment text change only
- `project.yml`: added YAML comments explaining the version-pin semantics; the `exactVersion: 1.2.3` pin itself is unchanged

There are no new sinks, no changed control flow, no changed validators, no changed permissions/entitlements, no changed inputs, no changed logging, and no changed dependency versions. The YAML changes are within a `#` comment block and do not alter any Swift Package resolution.

Per the method: with zero + lines that reach any sink or change any gate, there is nothing to trace. Reporting findings here would be pure fabrication.
